text:

Research
Kelcie Ralph is an Associate Professor at Rutgers, the State University of New Jersey.
💡 Dr. Ralph’s research focuses on the politics of transportation and the slow pace of reform. See all publications on Google Scholar.


Teaching
Professor Ralph teaches at the Bloustein School of Planning and Public Policy, where she teaches three graduate classes:

🚗 Introduction to Transportation Planning
🌲 Transportation and Environmental Issues
🚲 Bicycle and Pedestrian Planning

And two undergraduate classes:

🚗 Transportation Planning
🌇 Designing Healthy Cities



Education

University of California, Los Angeles PhD in Urban Planning | 2015
University of Cambridge MPhil, Environmental Policy | 2011
London School of Economics MSc, City Design and Social Science | 2010
University of Alaska, Anchorage BA, Economics | 2009
